import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 15;
    
    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
        static final int M = 2 * N * C + N + 7;
        
        int[] par = new int[N];
        int[] first = new int[N];
        int[] nxt = new int[2 * M];
        int[] ep = new int[2 * M];
        int m;
        long[] flo = new long[2 * M];
        long[] cap = new long[2 * M];
        long[] cost = new long[2 * M];
        
        void init() {
            m = 0;
            Arrays.fill(first, -1);
            Arrays.fill(flo, 0);
        }
        
        void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            nxt[m] = first[ep[m] = a];
            first[ep[m]] = m;
            cap[m] = c;
            cost[m] = p;
            ++m;
            
            nxt[m] = first[ep[m] = b];
            first[ep[m]] = m;
            cap[m] = 0;
            cost[m] = -p;
            ++m;
        }
        
        int[] q = new int[N];
        int[] inq = new int[N];
        boolean[] vis = new boolean[N];
        long[] pot = new long[N];
        long[] dist = new long[N];
        
        void mcf_pot_init(int n) {
            Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
            for (int k = 1; k < n; ++k) {
                for (int e = 0; e < m; ++e) {
                    if (cap[e] > 0) {
                        pot[ep[e ^ 1]] = Math.min(pot[ep[e ^ 1]], pot[ep[e]] + cost[e]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        long mcf_update(int s, int t, long[] price, int n) {
            Arrays.fill(vis, false);
            Arrays.fill(dist, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2);
            dist[s] = 0;
            Arrays.fill(inq, -1);
            
            int qs = 0;
            inq[q[qs++] = s] = 0;
            
            while (qs > 0) {
                int u = q[0];
                inq[u] = -1;
                q[0] = q[--qs];
                if (qs > 0) {
                    inq[q[0]] = 0;
                }
                
                for (int i = 0, j = 2 * i + 1, temp; j < qs; i = j, j = 2 * i + 1) {
                    if (j + 1 < qs && dist[q[j + 1]] < dist[q[j]]) {
                        j++;
                    }
                    if (dist[q[j]] >= dist[q[i]]) {
                        break;
                    }
                    // Swap in q array
                    temp = q[i];
                    q[i] = q[j];
                    q[j] = temp;
                    // Swap in inq array
                    temp = inq[q[i]];
                    inq[q[i]] = inq[q[j]];
                    inq[q[j]] = temp;
                }
                
                if (vis[u]) {
                    continue;
                }
                vis[u] = true;
                
                for (int e = first[u]; e != -1; e = nxt[e]) {
                    int v = ep[e ^ 1];
                    if (flo[e] < cap[e] && dist[v] > dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[v] + cost[e]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[v] + cost[e];
                        par[v] = e;
                        if (inq[v] < 0) {
                            inq[q[qs] = v] = qs;
                            qs++;
                        }
                        for (int i = inq[v], j = (i - 1) / 2, temp; dist[q[i]] < dist[q[j]]; i = j, j = (i - 1) / 2) {
                            // Swap in q array
                            temp = q[i];
                            q[i] = q[j];
                            q[j] = temp;
                            // Swap in inq array
                            temp = inq[q[i]];
                            inq[q[i]] = inq[q[j]];
                            inq[q[j]] = temp;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            
            if (dist[t] >= Long.MAX_VALUE / 2) {
                return 0;
            }
            
            long df = Long.MAX_VALUE;
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                df = Math.min(df, cap[e] - flo[e]);
            }
            
            for (int e, i = t; i != s; i = ep[e]) {
                e = par[i];
                flo[e] += df;
                flo[e ^ 1] -= df;
                price[0] += df * cost[e];
            }
            
            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
            
            return df;
        }
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        final int source = 0;
        final int sink = n * T + 1;
        Flow flow = new Flow();
        flow.init();
        
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }
        
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, Long.MAX_VALUE / 2, c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }
        
        flow.mcf_pot_init(Flow.N);
        long[] price = {0};
        long flowValue = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = flow.mcf_update(source, sink, price, Flow.N);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flowValue += df;
        }
        
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
